message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout that lasted longer than I expected! I grabbed my trusty flashlight and some power banks to keep our phones charged. But instead of scrolling through screens, my family and I dug out the old board games from the closet. We laughed, shared stories, and rediscovered the joy of low-tech fun together. Sometimes, a little darkness can spark the brightest moments! What’s your favorite way to pass the time during a power outage? 🌟
